name: Unstable Column (5-6) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
description: Plaster crumbles from this column moments before it collapses.
disable: DC 22 Crafting (trained) to stabilize the column, DC 25 Athletics to push the column back into place

generalAbilities.name: Collapse
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature steps on the tiles adjacent to the column

Effect The column collapses. The triggering creature must attempt a Basic DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw save as debris falls on them, which deals (4d8+10) Bludgeoning Damage damage. The area adjacent to the collapsed column becomes difficult terrain.
